proofs.claim: Every referenced identity has an explicit edition and lifecycle status.
Declared outcomes, constraints and non-goals are not internally contradictory.
Every intent term resolves to exactly one meaning in one bounded context or an explicit ACL translation.
Every semantic term has one authoritative owner in scope.
Imports, exports, exclusions and neighbor relationships are explicit.
Every non-canonical reference is bound by an evidence-bearing assertion whose relation is equivalent, narrower, broader, overlap, disjoint or missing-canonical-concept; spelling is never proof.

Every governed assertion identifies whether it is asset identity, descriptive metadata, catalog listing, certification, technical schema, semantic model, glossary, taxonomy or ontology content and cannot inherit authority across kinds.
Ontology or taxonomy mappings state exact editions, relation semantics, inference profile, direction, loss and authority; broader/narrower/overlap is never promoted to equivalence.
Question, actors, population, unit, grain, time, inputs, outputs, assumptions, failures, decision/action and feedback are complete.
No KPI, formula or dashboard tile substitutes for an analytical case.
Every analytical practice has applicable input, output, assumptions, uncertainty and evaluation contracts.
Every selected analytical method is applicable to the case population, grain, time, assumptions, objective, uncertainty and evaluation contract, with rejected alternatives retained.

Every compiled analytical path preserves distinct identities and evidence for business question, practice, study design, formal method, algorithm, kernel, reusable library, execution environment and independently adopted product; no label substitutes for a missing layer.

Every vertical solution pack declares product compositions and provider-neutral analytical method contracts separately, and neither a product name nor an industry label selects a method or implementation by implication.
The observation, sampling, assignment or experimental design can identify or validly estimate the declared target under explicit assumptions and diagnostics.
The estimand or decision target is defined independently of the estimator, and the estimator is valid for that target, population, time, grain and missingness posture.
Fitting, tuning, selection and evaluation populations and cuts satisfy the study contract and cannot leak through caches, preprocessing or repeated selection.
Every causal claim has estimand, design, identification assumptions, diagnostics and sensitivity analysis.
Forecast horizon, information set, uncertainty and rolling evaluation match the decision.
Decision variables, objectives, constraints, uncertainty, feasibility and solution guarantee are explicit.
Every required fact names its source authority, replicas and reconciliation rule.
Required discovery/read/change/write semantics are offered by the source class and occurrence.
Snapshot and change capture have a common cut, resume token, retention and reconciliation.
Carrier, value, observation and structure semantics are compatible without invalid inference.
Semantic type, carrier, encoding, framing, layout, container, codec and protection identities are explicit and every lossy layer has an authorized finite error contract.
Keys, cardinality, nesting, order, topology and change semantics are explicit.
Every input/output grain is declared and joins cannot create unapproved fanout.
Namespace, key, lifecycle, collision, merge/split and uncertainty semantics are explicit.
Similarity produces a match candidate only; identity assertion, match/non-match/review decision and merge/split each require their declared authority and preserve prior evidence.
Authoritative master fields, reproducible survivorship/golden projections, reference datasets and code sets retain distinct provenance, effective time and maintenance authority.
Event, valid, recording, ingestion and processing times are distinct where applicable.
Dimensions, units, numeric policy and conversion evidence are complete.
Missingness, censoring, measurement error and model uncertainty are not collapsed.
Every logical operation has typed inputs, outputs, errors and semantic owner.
Preconditions, postconditions, algebraic laws, refusals and failures are satisfiable.
Every lossy transform declares lost information and has authority to lose it.
Batch, stream and incremental variants agree under declared finality or expose differences.
Every stateful operation has finite retention/resource bounds or an explicit refusal.
Security, privacy, purpose, residency, retention and disclosure policies have deterministic precedence.
A policy statement is compiled through an editioned policy decision to a scoped enforcement action and immutable receipt; listing, certification or approval alone never grants access.
Accountability, delegation, stewardship, custody, approval and entitlement are separately scoped role assignments with validity and revocation.
Every approval, override, waiver, write and external effect has accountable authority.
Privacy unit, contribution bounds, composition and release budget are valid.
Quality rules cover critical contracts and distinguish observation from disposition.
A declared contract and sampled observed behavior retain separate identities; observation cannot silently amend the declaration.
Detection emits a scoped signal, adjudication assigns authorized meaning, gate disposition applies policy and correction requires separate mutation authority.

Reconciliation binds identified populations, matching/equality or tolerance, timing, source/accounting/control truth roles and break authority without treating one record as its own independent control.
Every correction or restatement preserves prior identity and evidence, applies under authority, reruns affected controls and emits a new release/certification decision.
Selected offers implement exact semantic contracts and operation laws.
Every selected algorithm realizes the required method or operation under satisfied preconditions, complexity/resource bounds, stopping law and declared guarantee posture.
Every selected kernel is qualified for the exact operation, types, layouts, target, numeric posture, concurrency, cancellation and resource envelope.
A qualification profile or provider declaration is not a passing receipt; required conformance, numerical, resource and failure tests executed against the exact artifact and target.

Every product-facing library contract group decomposes into exact concrete capability requirements and explicit blocking gaps; an abstract group, product label or provider package is never directly bindable.

Every substitution claim fixes the contract edition, operations, types, semantic and numerical laws, target, resource/failure behavior, qualification profiles and independent implementations; output similarity or a common package label is insufficient.
Semantic exactness, approximation error, run determinism and cross-target reproducibility are proved independently and no weaker guarantee is promoted to a stronger one.
A provider capability class is bound only through a versioned deployed occurrence whose configuration, target, observed limits and evidence validity are current.
Every selected protocol and format profile has exact editions, feature subsets, compatibility behavior and cross-implementation conformance evidence; a product name or file extension is insufficient.
Provider conformance evidence is current and scoped to the selected version and target.
Every applicable configuration decision is explicitly bound by its authority.
Latency, throughput, memory, storage, network, energy and cost fit finite budgets.
Every blocking resource demand has a registered dimension, unit, minimum/target/maximum, elasticity and topology constraints; unknown or unbounded demand is refused.
Quota, budget/precharge authority and admission are proved independently of current physical capacity and placement feasibility.
The scheduling result truthfully states optimal-with-proof, bounded-gap, feasible, heuristic-at-budget, probabilistic, infeasible or timeout posture and never promotes a heuristic result to optimal.
Reservation, committed allocation, release and rollback transitions preserve capacity-ledger invariants under races and failures.
Selected targets preserve required types, effects, concurrency, cancellation and evidence.
External actions have idempotency, authorization, receipt, reconciliation and compensation or irreversibility posture.
Lease expiry and revocation are enforced by a fencing token at the protected effect; a lease record alone is insufficient.
Requested, reserved, allocated, observed, rated and billed quantities retain distinct identities and reconcile through evidence-bearing transforms.
Every deployment occurrence fixes implementation artifact, version, configuration, provider occurrence, target and validity without inheriting product or suite identity as semantics.
Checkpoint, resume, retry, replay, backfill and restore preserve declared semantics.
Compatibility, in-flight work, historical replay, rollback/roll-forward and decommission are explicit.
Every SLO has measurement, alert, owner, runbook and error-budget action.
Every material output links sources, operations, versions, parameters, authorities and receipts.
Invalid, unsupported, not-identified, non-converged, cancelled, numerically suspect and successful results remain distinct terminal outcomes with claim boundaries.
Declared vertical decision outcomes and negative twins pass acceptance or remain blocking gaps.
Generated solution has portability, supplier-exit, data-export and decommission evidence.

Every no-change or freshness conclusion names the monitored subjects, source occurrences, successful collection attempts, observation window and uncovered sources; collection failure cannot support absence.
Every change fixes the exact subject identity, edition, prior/new state, effective and observation times, affected scopes and supporting primary evidence.
A candidate signal becomes a verified change event only after scoped primary evidence and contradictory or superseding evidence have been evaluated.
The exact transitive dependency graph, lock/resolution policy, vulnerability state, compatibility constraints and removal seams are known for every selected artifact.
Upgrade, pin or rollback decisions evaluate security exposure and availability/recovery behavior independently, record trade-off authority and retain rejected alternatives.
A documented provider release is not assumed present: region, channel, account, target occurrence, effective time and observed behavior are verified before binding.
Every changed default is bound as an explicit versioned decision with compatibility, in-flight work, backfill, rollback and historical interpretation consequences.
Dry-run, simulation and validation paths are proven not to perform prohibited external effects, including after partial authorization or error paths; effectful execution emits a distinct receipt.
Every verified change is impact-mapped to exact bindings, offers, dependencies, defaults, proofs and deployments, and all invalidated subjects remain unusable until requalified or explicitly waived.

Every derived object or execution state names its state definition, leading-object scope, source attributes, temporal evaluation law, totality/missingness policy and derivation provenance; a state label is never assumed to be an observed fact.

A generated state-change event has a distinct identity and derivation receipt, preserves its source attribute transition and tie-order policy, and cannot be mistaken for an event emitted by the source system.
Every temporal entity snapshot identifies the entity, validity interval or boundary, source attribute history and event-correlation rule; snapshot identity is never promoted to entity identity.

Every OCED, OCEL, event-graph or temporal-graph transform fixes exact source/target profiles and proves identity, multiplicity, order, time, qualifiers and information-loss behavior in both directions where claimed.

Every case notion and case-centric projection declares selected objects, execution boundaries, event duplication/omission, shared-object behavior and analysis-specific loss; no universal partition is inferred from object-centric data.

Removing every optional model/agent contribution leaves core domain meanings, typed operations, bindings, authorization, effect controls and acceptance proofs well formed or exposes a pre-existing typed capability gap.

Every operation use site explicitly selects PROHIBITED, OPTIONAL, REQUIRED_BY_INTENT or UNDETERMINED for model/agent participation after its deterministic types, invariants, authority, budgets and acceptance oracle exist; no product or domain name implies an AI default.

Every agent-assisted path still emits the independent deterministic receipts required for parsing, typechecking, constraint solving, numerical execution, qualification, authorization and acceptance; an agent proposal cannot discharge any of those obligations.
Every selected model capability fixes the exact artifact, edition, provider occurrence, task/input/output contract, context/prompt policy, limits, data-use posture and current qualification evidence.

Model nondeterminism, evaluation population, scoring laws, uncertainty, known failure slices, fallback and monitoring are explicit; a benchmark or vendor claim is not a deployed qualification receipt.

A model output or agent plan becomes an external effect only through schema validation, deterministic policy checks, scoped authority, an explicit tool invocation intent and a separately recorded execution receipt.

Every research artifact resolves exact work and edition identities, authorship evidence, date/venue/version status and relationships to preprint, proceedings, journal, specification, code and dataset expressions.

Every person-to-contribution edge states an evidence-backed role such as authorship, formalization, implementation, maintenance, standardization, supervision or replication; topic proximity and reputation are inadmissible attribution evidence.

Every imported research claim retains its problem, definitions, assumptions, population/data, method, comparator, result, uncertainty, limitations and supported scope; a paper title or abstract is insufficient.

Contradictory results, failed or partial replications, limitations, retractions, corrections and superseding work remain attached as scoped defeaters rather than being erased by a newer or more cited artifact.

A research contribution maps separately to candidate concept, practice, method, operation, representation, algorithm, kernel, library or proof identities, and no mapping is promoted to canonical equivalence or a bindable offer without adjudication and qualification.
The prediction target, population, unit, outcome/label definition, horizon, information cutoff, decision use and abstention/partial-result states are fixed independently of model selection.
Every feature, label, preprocessing state and cached artifact is available by the declared information cutoff and cannot leak future, target, entity, group or evaluation information.
Training, tuning, model selection, calibration and evaluation cuts are population-, group-, entity- and time-safe and repeated search is accounted for in evaluation evidence.
Training objective, regularization, model-selection score, calibration criterion, deployment metric and enterprise decision cost remain distinct and are each appropriate to the target and use.

Scores, calibrated probabilities, intervals, sets or distributions state their calibration population, coverage/scoring law, uncertainty and known invalidation conditions; point accuracy cannot substitute.
Prediction results become recommendations or decisions only through an explicit threshold/utility/cost/constraint/abstention policy with scoped authority and human role.

Production monitoring distinguishes input, label, target, calibration, performance and policy drift; retraining, recalibration, rollback and retirement require explicit triggers, data cuts, evaluation and release authority.
Predictive performance or feature importance is not promoted to causal effect, intervention consequence or policy benefit without a separate causal estimand and identification proof.
